items.title: Local Lefschetz full faithfulness for the etale punctured neighbourhood under a dualizing complex, henselian pair, and either an S-2 plus three-dimensional-component condition or a depth-versus-dimension inequality strictly above two.
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The load-bearing reduction is proved: all hypotheses are shown stable under passing to the m-adic completion. Existence of the dualizing complex and the henselian pair are immediate; the depth-dimension inequality is transported by the named local-cohomology completion-change lemma; for the S-2 alternative the ring is universally catenary by the dualizing reference, hence every component of the completed spectrum away from the hypersurface has dimension at least three via the Ratliff proposition, and the flat map with Gorenstein fibres carries the S-2 condition from the localization to its completion through the cited formal-fibres sections and the S-k going-up lemma. With stability established, the henselian-completion transfer lemma reduces to the complete case, and the chapter imports the algebraization comparison for the final statement. The reduction chain is the substance and sits in the span.
